title: BBC staff face uncertain future after low pay offer
summary: BBC staff are concerned about their jobs amid plans to cut thousands of positions and a below-inflation pay rise offer. The corporation is preparing for potential strike action as unions reject the proposal. Teachers in England have received a higher pay rise, but concerns remain about funding.
summary_points: BBC staff face uncertainty due to low pay offer
Thousands of jobs at risk amid restructuring plans
Unions reject below-inflation pay rise offer
Teachers in England receive higher pay rise with some concerns about funding
Potential strike action looms for BBC staff
